newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 5.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 5.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:
* The Dow Jones rounded out a strong week, jumping 94.72 points to 7,071.20 on Friday - within 14 points of its record 7,085.16 set on March 11. For the week, the Dow gained 332.33 points, a record.

* Indonesian soldiers wielding sticks dispersed a demonstration by Moslem youths in the central Javan city of Yogyakarta early on Sunday as tensions between contestants in Indonesia's election continued to rise.
* On Friday, the Jakarta Composite Index fell 2.56 points, or 0.39 percent, to close at 647.89 points.
* On Monday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,427.25/27.50 at 0205 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,429.00/30.00.

* Petrochemical giant Tri Polyta after reports rating agency Standard & Poor Corp has lowered its long-term corporate credit rating on Tri Polyta to B-Plus from BB-Minus and has revised its outlook to negative from stable.
* Small textile firm Pan Brothers Tex on reports of a possible delisting following poor financial condition.
* Bank Bira and Ciputra Development on reports of a link-up between the Bira Group and the Ciputra Group to build a large property project in Jakarta.
* BNI, Asahimas, Bimantara, Citra Marga and Gudang Garam following news of the new composition of the Morgan Stanley Capital Index (MSCI).
